build.overlap: Same precompiled Hermes -O bytecode on all hosts

clock: All hosts use __now(). Native before/after rebuilt with identical console-only steady_clock patch. Sub-millisecond monotonic clock checks pass. Historical native timings used Date.now fallback; low-percent differences should be assessed within this paired run.
order: Three complete 33-case overlap invocations plus canonical and isolated Locale controls per host. Rounds 1 and 3 before/after/magrinj; round 2 reverses. No builds or profiling during timings.
outputChecks: 342 values checked (297 overlap, 27 canonical tag controls, 18 isolated Locale controls). All FormatJS before/after values match; all controls match all hosts. Only overlap comparator differences: omitted/unsupported ListFormat default locale en-US versus en.
change: Return canonical ASCII plain decimals of at most 308 bytes directly from shared mathematical normalization. Such text is provably finite and already normalized; preserve general parsing and BigInt paths.

conformance.gates: Ten focused gates pass: Rust plural core, mathematical and digit differentials; Hermes NumberFormat/PluralRules source/optimized bytecode; Chromium compiled source/bytecode matrix; both Test262 suites; pinned ICU4C/J and ICU4X checks.
conformance.rangeMatrix: Inherited 224 cardinal ranges over 14 locales, with all 18 raw ICU implementation differences preserved.
conformance.observableBehavior: Canonical values checked against general exponent form at 308-byte boundaries; 309-digit overflow and finite long values retain clamping behavior. Noncanonical, invalid, radix, exponent, rounding and exact BigInt differential cases pass.
conformance.consumer: Nine SDK API smoke scripts pass.

probeLimits: Separate counting and uninstrumented timing binaries, 10000 allocation loops or 100000 timing loops per case. Single diagnostic runs, not authoritative cross-implementation timings. Range second endpoint is the canonical string 4, so fallback first-endpoint cases can still improve.
timingChange: Every host pinned to CPU 0 for this complete comparison. Historical tables used unpinned processes; assess code effects within this paired run.
profileNote: Fresh before/after profiles from the exact optimized SDK hosts, pinned to CPU 0. No profiling or builds during timings.
limits: Several constructor and steady-state gaps remain. No whole-goal completion claim.

commands.benchmark: Build SDK and all three optimized workloads with Bazel; apply native-clock.patch to pinned standalone console host and rebuild both native variants with CMake; run each cquery workload on each optimized host.
